name: Aspiring Scientists Summer Internship Program (ASSIP)
org: George Mason University, College of Science
what_you_do: Work full time for 8 weeks on a one-on-one research project with a George Mason faculty mentor, in person, remote or hybrid, and present at a final poster session.
who_can_apply: High school and undergraduate students. Minimum age 15 by Jun 18, 2026 for remote or computer-lab internships and 16 for in-person wet-lab internships. No minimum GPA; transcripts are not requested.
pay_detail: $25 application fee and, if offered an internship, $1,299 tuition for 3 undergraduate credits. Both can be waived with demonstrated financial need.
duration: 8 weeks, full time (Jun 18 to Aug 12 in 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 ASSIP Application is now closed. The page posts no date for the 2027 cycle.
how_to_apply: Online application with a personal statement; interested mentors interview strong candidates and offers go out in early April. Request a fee waiver code from cosassip@gmu.edu if needed.
notes: Labs are at the Fairfax campus, the Science and Technology Campus in Manassas, or Woodbridge; students arrange their own transportation and campus housing cannot be arranged for minors. This is a paid-by-the-student internship, not a job, so no work permit.
